questions.solution:
$p:$ probability of getting head

$q:$ probability of getting tail

Such that, $p + q = 1$

Hence required probability $= qp\left(1 + {q}^{2} + {q}^{4} + \ldots\right) = \dfrac{2}{5}$

$⇒ 5p - 5{p}^{2} = 2 - 2( 1 + {p}^{2} - 2p )$

$⇒ 5p - 5{p}^{2} = 2 - 2 - 2{p}^{2} + 4p$

$⇒ 3{p}^{2} = p$

$⇒ p( 3p - 1 ) = 0$

$⇒ p = 0, p = \dfrac{1}{3}$

$∵ p \ne 0$

$∴ p = \dfrac{1}{3}$

$⇒ 9p = 3$
